text: Communication Studies is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the laws of human information transmission, understanding and interaction, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as psychology, sociology, linguistics, communication studies and management. The course focuses on "how to effectively convey information, build relationships and resolve conflicts", aiming to cultivate professional talents with oral expression, written communication, cross-cultural communication and media application skills. It is applicable to multiple scenarios such as the workplace, education and public affairs.
